<tspan x="698.0" dy="0">Output</tspan>
</text>

<tspan x="665.0" dy="0">B=batch; C=192; no mixing across batch or channels; shape unchanged.</tspan>
<tspan x="665.0" dy="16.52">Retained x enters normalization Multiply; independent gamma,beta,tau enter their own operators.</tspan>
<tspan x="665.0" dy="16.52">Parameter panel is containment only, no fake sequence between gamma/beta/tau/eps.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="665.0" y="712" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="665.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="665.0" y="742" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="665.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="665.0" y="767" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="665.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
